knowledge.title: Capability audit and promotion rule
knowledge.summary: Promote capabilities only after runtime, build, and behavior evidence agree.
knowledge.content: The capability audit baseline recorded for build 1076226 separates verified, experimental, research-only, and unsupported work. A capability should move toward stable status only after its runtime boundary, current-build compatibility, and relevant in-game behavior are independently documented. Successful offline generation alone is not proof of in-game behavior.

knowledge.title: Capability status labels
knowledge.summary: Separate verified, experimental, research-only, and blocked work.
knowledge.content: Verified route means the documented boundary has passed its evidence requirements. Experimental means controlled testing is possible while important questions remain. Research-only belongs in an isolated profile or disposable world. Blocked means a missing dependency, unsafe boundary, or unresolved failure prevents promotion.

knowledge.title: Evidence before in-game claims
knowledge.summary: An offline build or registration result does not prove visible in-game behavior.
knowledge.content: Treat successful validation, packaging, or runtime registration as an intermediate result only. A feature should remain experimental or research-only until the target Enshrouded build has fresh runtime evidence and, where relevant, in-game visual confirmation. Record the build context and limitations before promoting the result.

knowledge.title: Furniture registration is not visual proof
knowledge.summary: A resource registration route does not prove complete rendering behavior.
knowledge.content: The recorded furniture research demonstrates an independent ItemInfo registration route for a specific build. Catalog exposure, mesh and texture rendering, multiplayer behavior, and complete visual presentation require separate evidence. Keep the work in a disposable test world while those boundaries remain research-only.

knowledge.title: Gameplay settings require an adapter
knowledge.summary: Staged tuning is portable input, not a direct game mutation.
knowledge.content: The installation exposes client preference settings but no supported native gameplay-tuning document. EmberVault therefore exports staged profile values and keeps live application behind an explicitly identified mod or tuning adapter that declares its input contract, backup requirements, mutation scope, and verification procedure.

knowledge.title: Module boundaries
knowledge.summary: Modules use contracts and explicit capability boundaries.
knowledge.content: Normal workflows can be embedded in Control Center. Trainer, Research, and other higher-risk tools may run as separate processes with an explicit launch context.

knowledge.title: Profiles and isolation
knowledge.summary: Use separate profiles for stable play and research.
knowledge.content: The Default profile is intended for stable play. The Research profile is an isolated surface for experimental settings and evidence.

knowledge.title: Save safety workflow
knowledge.summary: Inspect and protect saves before experiments.
knowledge.content: Save Manager is inspection, backup, verification, restore preview, and safe restore only. It does not directly edit save contents.

research.title: Offline Catalog
research.summary: The recorded rebuild normalized ItemInfo, ItemRegistry, recipe, blueprint, terrain, building, material, feedback, and snap-rule relationships for its named input bundle.
research.content: The recorded rebuild normalized ItemInfo, ItemRegistry, recipe, blueprint, terrain, building, material, feedback, and snap-rule relationships for its named input bundle.
limitations: The recorded counts are not universal game totals and do not prove runtime mutation or compatibility with later builds.
open_questions: Can the normalized catalog be imported into the Research index with reproducible source hashes?

research.title: external-blender-kfc3-rendermodel-workflow
research.summary: The reviewed external Blender workflow documents offline KFC3 RenderModel search, mesh/material import, topology-preserving export, and generated EML package structure.
research.content: The reviewed external Blender workflow documents offline KFC3 RenderModel search, mesh/material import, topology-preserving export, and generated EML package structure.
limitations: The workflow does not prove fresh-session success, arbitrary component support, custom icon registration, or unrestricted generated-asset behavior.
open_questions: Which build-target, texture-slot, topology, and inherited-recipe checks should be mandatory before package handoff?

research.title: Blender Handoff
research.summary: The external Blender workflow can provide RenderModel, entity-template, ItemInfo, recipe, and localization package output for offline review.
research.content: The external Blender workflow can provide RenderModel, entity-template, ItemInfo, recipe, and localization package output for offline review.
limitations: Generated package success does not establish in-game rendering, placement, persistence, or multiplayer behavior.
open_questions: Can the handoff metadata be imported without copying or modifying the original Blender export?

research.title: vanilla-content-donor-probe-contract
research.summary: The documented donor probe captures item identity, GUID, debug name, equipment, and voxel-object fields without creating items or changing registries or saves.
research.content: The documented donor probe captures item identity, GUID, debug name, equipment, and voxel-object fields without creating items or changing registries or saves.
limitations: The procedure does not identify a universal donor or prove that captured fields are sufficient for safe cloning.
open_questions: Which captured donor fields are stable across builds and sufficient for Content Creator handoff?

research.title: eml-live-resource-registration-discovery
research.summary: The recorded loader change exposed newly registered resources to resource enumeration and direct lookup while suppressing duplicates.
research.content: The recorded loader change exposed newly registered resources to resource enumeration and direct lookup while suppressing duplicates.
limitations: Resource discovery alone does not establish valid UI arrays, recipe registries, knowledge gates, or general game-side compatibility.
open_questions: Which typed descriptors and registries must be validated before a newly registered resource is a Content Creator candidate?

research.title: Package Validation
research.summary: Blender and generated package outputs can be reviewed for expected metadata, paths, hashes, and validation results without installing them.
research.content: Blender and generated package outputs can be reviewed for expected metadata, paths, hashes, and validation results without installing them.
limitations: Offline package validation does not prove in-game rendering or behavior.
open_questions: Which package metadata fields should be mandatory for Content Creator handoff?

research.title: recipe-knowledge-requirement-assignment
research.summary: A recorded isolated session accepted guarded clearing and replacement of a cloned recipe knowledge requirement without panic or registration failure.
research.content: A recorded isolated session accepted guarded clearing and replacement of a cloned recipe knowledge requirement without panic or registration failure.
limitations: Assignment acceptance does not prove catalog unlock behavior, craftability, completion, or persistence.
open_questions: Which knowledge registry and consumer checks govern actual unlock and crafting behavior?

research.title: Recipe Schema
research.summary: The research identifies recipe structures and separates schema discovery from runtime UI consumption.
research.content: The research identifies recipe structures and separates schema discovery from runtime UI consumption.
limitations: Schema fields alone do not prove that a custom recipe will appear, craft, persist, or work in multiplayer.
open_questions: Which recipe registry and knowledge gates are authoritative for the target build?

research.title: recipe-workshop-and-required-properties-assignment
research.summary: A recorded isolated session accepted typed workshop replacement and required-property clearing on an independent cloned recipe.
research.content: A recorded isolated session accepted typed workshop replacement and required-property clearing on an independent cloned recipe.
limitations: Registration without loader error does not prove catalog display, crafting completion, save persistence, or multiplayer behavior.
open_questions: Which workstation and required-property combinations are accepted by the target build's crafting consumer?

research.title: external-rendermodel-publication-route
research.summary: A recorded disposable-copy experiment accepted a replacement iconModel GUID and completed item, registry, recipe, knowledge, UI-link, recipe-GUID, and archive checks before transactional cleanup.
research.content: A recorded disposable-copy experiment accepted a replacement iconModel GUID and completed item, registry, recipe, knowledge, UI-link, recipe-GUID, and archive checks before transactional cleanup.
limitations: The experiment does not prove catalog display, placed-object rendering, persistence, multiplayer behavior, or client_rendering_verified status.
open_questions: Which package and runtime evidence fields are mandatory before Content Creator can treat this as a donor-preserving design candidate?

research.title: rendermodel-guid-to-resource-family-resolution
research.summary: A recorded session resolved a concrete GUID to a keen::RenderModel resource on the specified EML/game build.
research.content: A recorded session resolved a concrete GUID to a keen::RenderModel resource on the specified EML/game build.
limitations: The evidence does not prove that assigning another RenderModel changes a cloned item's placed appearance.
open_questions: Can a donor-preserving RenderModel substitution be verified with controlled screenshots without promoting it to runtime capability?
